responsibility: Declares the selftest implementation of logical_locations::manager used by diagnostics tests. The test_manager creates and owns simple name-based logical-location items, reports them as function-kind locations with no parent hierarchy, and gives selftest paths and SARIF-related tests a tree-free source of logical location keys and names.
same_name_distinction: Declares the selftest logical_locations::manager subclass, its item storage layout, and the public API for creating logical-location keys from function names. Unlike selftest-logical-locations.cc, it provides the type and method declarations rather than the map-management logic and selftests.
